text:
ENERĞİYÜM AL-YOM AL-AM
Tatmiein al-qalb wa al-sakinah al-dakhiliyah huma simat hadha al-yom al-jamil ya mawlid burj al-sartan. Yuhituka taqa ijabiyyah kabirah tusaiduka ala tajawuz ay shubuhat aw qalaq qadim kan yuzaqiq fikrak. Al-mizaj al-aam yumtaz bil-hudu' wa al-qodrah al-aliyah ala tafahum masha'ir man hawlak bi-shakl amiq jiddan. Innahu waqt mithali li-i'adat tartib awlawiyatika al-nafsiyyah wa al-fikriyah bi-ma yatasmah ma'a ruhtika al-jamīlah.

AL-HUBB WA AL-ALAQAT
Li-man yumlikuna al-sharik, al-yom yahmilu ma'ahu thawrah min al-tahafum al-mutabadil wa al-taqrib al-atifi al-khas. Satajidu al-wasa'il al-munasibah li-ta'bir an mashairika bi-sedq yabni jisr min al-thiqa al-mutawasilah ma'a al-habib. Amma al-ozzab, fa-al-falak yushir ila ihtimaliya li-liqaa ghir mutawaqa' qad yuhrik qalbika wa yu'id al-amal fi al-bidayat al-jadidah. Kun musta'iddan li-qabul al-hubb bi-qalb maftuh wa rooh mutafailah.

AL-AMAL WA AL-KARIYAR
Fi majal al-amal, tatamatta' al-yom bi-qudrah fariqah ala al-tarkiz wa injaz al-maham al-mu'allaqah bi-kafa'ah aaliyah. Qad tatlaqa i'tiran aw taqdiran min al-ru'asa' ala juhudika al-madiyah allati qumta biha fi al-fatrah al-sabiqah. Istafid min hadha al-yawm al-muthmir li-tawjih afkar ibda'iyyah jadidah qad tufiduka fi tatwir masarik al-mihni mustaqblan. La tatawaddad fi tardi al-furs allati tastahiquha bi-jadd wa ikhlas.

AL-MAL WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad' al-madi ya'rifu istiqrarah malhuzan yuj'aluka tash'ur bil-itminan al-mali al-nafsiy. Hunaka fursah la-i'adat tanzim mizaniyatika aw istithmar zakiy fi mashro' saghir qad yu'ti thimarah qariban. Ala raghm min hadha, yufadhal al-tanaffus al-mali wa tajannub al-mashrat al-ghayr al-darouriyyah li-hafiz ala hadha al-istiqrar al-jamil. Al-barakah tuhituka kullama kunta mutawazi'an wa shaakiran lima tamlik.

AL-SIHHA WA AL-TAQA
Jasaman wa zihniyan, anta fi afdal halah idha akhtart al-ihtimam bi-rahatika al-dakhiliyah. Numu al-nafs al-saliha yahtaj ila qist min al-nawm al-'amiq wa al-tanaffus al-amiq fi makan tabi'i hadi'. Imtani' an al-tafkir al-za'id fi al-umur al-ghayr muhimmah li-la tunfiq taqataka al-thaminah bila fa'idah. Al-akhl al-sihiyyah wa shurb al-ma'a bi-kammiyyat kafiyah satziduka nishatan wa hayawiyatan.

AL-TAWASUL WA AL-MUHIT
Al-wasat al-i'tima'i hawlak yumtaz bil-da'm al-qwi wa al-mahabba al-sadiqah. Qad tatlaqa da'wah min sadiq qadim aw qarib yu'id ila qalbika al-bahjah wa al-surur al-kabir. Hawaraka ma'a afrad al-usrah satakun akthar dafi'an wa tufahuman mimma yumahhid al-tariq li-hall ay khilafat basita saabiqah. Ihtafiz bi-ha'ula' al-ashkhas al-ladhin yamla'una hayatika bil-noor.

NASIHAT AL-YOM
Da' al-thiqah bi-nafsika takun hiya quwatika al-akbar wa la tans an tarama nafsika bi-kull al-hubb al-ladhi tu'tih lil-akharin.

TAFASEEL AL-YOM
Al-raqm al-mahzouz: 2
Al-lawn al-mahzouz: al-lwn al-fiddi
Al-burj al-mutawafiq ma'ahu: burj al-aqrab
